name: Bot Social Graph
description: Persistent social relationships for playerbots - bots remember who they played with and act on it. Six independent layers per bot (activity, character, gear motive, availability, career stage, anchor); guilds are founded organically by cliques instead of at server start.

steps: Run apply-playerbots-patches.ps1 (optional patches, and it checks AiPlayerbot.RandomBotGuildCount)
Set AiPlayerbot.RandomBotGuildCount = 0 in playerbots.conf - guild founding replaces it
Start worldserver (creates tables, applies SQL updates)

features: One-sided affection model (A likes B != B likes A)
Dunbar limit prevents infinite bond growth
Grudges fade slower than friendships
First impression bonus
Six independent layers per bot - what a bot DOES no longer dictates who it IS
Layer 1 activity: questor, dungeoneer, raider, pvper, gatherer, explorer, collector
Layer 2 character: five normal traits plus a heavy-tailed sadism roll (Volkmer 2023)
Layer 3 gear motive: derived from activity, stage and guild - never rolled
Layer 4 availability: four time profiles drawn JOINTLY, incl. a night profile across midnight
Layer 5 career stage: entry, practice, mastery, burnout, recovery
Layer 6 anchor: the one person a bot keeps logging in for - earned, never rolled
Guilds founded organically from mutual bonds, replacing playerbots' start-up guilds
Guild recruitment weighs overlapping play windows
Automatic promotions
Guild schisms when cliques split
Server-wide reputation system
In-game inspection commands (.social stats/bonds/grudges/who)
Optional ReactDelay patch: skill affects bot reaction time
Fully configurable without restart (OnAfterConfigLoad hook)
No dependency link to mod-playerbots

database.migration_note: Upgrading from 1.x REQUIRES 20260830_00_bot_social_layers.sql (14 new columns on bot_social_profile, 2 on bot_social_guild). It runs through AzerothCore's UpdateFetcher. Existing profiles keep bonds, reputation and activity; their layer values are rolled the next time each bot does something social - rows still waiting carry stage_since = 0 and should be excluded from statistics.

commands.name: .social who <name>
commands.description: Full profile: all six layers, skill tier and reputation

patches.description: Optional: Makes bot skill tier affect reaction time
Optional: Guards a null deref in PlayerbotGuildMgr::ValidateGuildCache

conflicts.reason: mod-playerbots creates guilds at server start and fills them with arbitrary bots, including level 1 characters that never met. BotSocial.Found replaces that; both at once makes no sense. The module logs an error at every start when the value is not 0, and the patch installer warns before you build. Neither ever writes playerbots.conf - that file belongs to another module.
